description: North European energy system model, published by vttresearch, provides a North European energy-system model and input preparation workflow for the Backbone modelling framework. Coverage: The supplied model is for Northern Europe and includes electricity, district-heating and hydrogen scenario inputs. Spatial aggregation and time series depend on the selected setup. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The README requires the Backbone master branch and separate demand and renewable time-series sources. The public repository is not a self-contained runnable model; no dependencies were installed. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, optimisation studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
